scope: Field names and value domains of the registered results-record schema. 'records' names the columns of the measurement-record summary schema (records/specs.json: set keys plus summary_columns) that carry the field in this repository, 'results_csv' the columns of the run results table written by cross_morse/pipeline.py (final/results.csv), and 'evidence' the top-level fields of the per-run evidence record of paper/build/evidence.py. The generator checks every listed column against those schemas and derives each field's role from them.

backbone.values: frozen plant or substituted backbone (Table S5, S25)

checkpoint.values: checkpoint identifiers and the ensemble they form (E); repeated evaluations are separate records

policy.values: q_C (with its family and the selected rule), q̂_s, q_M, q̃_M, q_D, a comparator of Table S15 or an experimental arm (E2–E20)

profile.values: Lean, Full, inserted-site parameters, truncation order T and resolvent frequency actually executed

stage.values: D_fit, D_explore, D_select, D_confirm, D_compare, D_admit (validation), D_test; graph or cluster identities attached

unit.values: complete graph, buffered cluster (buffer in hops), official split, optimization seed

protocol.values: loss (clipped or unclipped, B), official metric, pairing, resampling hierarchy (E16)

score.values: native units; paired to the comparator record

uncertainty.values: interval with its resampling procedure and level

cost.values: serial work, wall time (protocol of E17), fitting cost with its accounting unit

identifier.values: path to the log or trace that produced the record
